Nurture
0:07
Target word: nurture /ˈnɜː.tʃər/ (verb/noun).
0:12
Definition: to "care for" & "encourage the growth or development" of someone/something; e.g. a child’s talent or an protégé's skills.
0:22
Example: "Nature versus nurture"—a perennial debate—illustrates how environment shapes one's character & temperament.
0:32
Collocations
0:35
Key collocations: "nurture talent", "nurture & protect", "carefully nurtured".
